environment.description: Same GKE 1.27 cluster, same namespace 'data-plane'. Istio 1.19 sidecar injected with STRICT mTLS (PeerAuthentication). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a default-deny posture (spec.action: DENY, spec.rules matching source.namespaces not in ['data-plane']). Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy with action ALLOW exists that permits only source principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/data-plane/sa/edge-gateway' to access paths matching '/api/v1/telemetry/*'. The edge-gateway service account's workload performs schema validation on the protobuf envelope, rejecting any payload where the declared length field exceeds 256 bytes before forwarding. External traffic enters only through the edge-gateway pod which has its own input validation. Direct pod-to-pod communication from other namespaces is rejected at the Envoy sidecar level before reaching the application container.

config.network_policies: Calico NetworkPolicy denying ingress from namespaces without label tier=data
